say:1:1060703001:1.text: There is no voice of the glimmerblooms... Y-You did it!
say:1:1060703001:1.source_cn: 荧荧花的声音消失了……你、你成功了！

choice_prompt:2:1060703001.text: There is no voice of the glimmerblooms... Y-You did it!
choice_prompt:2:1060703001.source_cn: 荧荧花的声音消失了……你、你成功了！

say:3:1060703002:1.text: No, I just didn't think you could make it so fast.
say:3:1060703002:1.source_cn: 不，我只是没想到，你居然这么快就解决了它们。

say:4:1060703003:1.text: We need to keep improving our sword skills...
say:4:1060703003:1.source_cn: 看来，我们三个的剑技还需要不断精进……

say:5:1060703004:1.text: Thanks to you, we can finally leave this place. The two of them have to hurry back to treat their injuries.
say:5:1060703004:1.source_cn: 还没有向你道谢呢。多亏了你，我们终于能离开这里了，他们...

say:6:1060703005:1.text: Thank you so much for your help!
say:6:1060703005:1.source_cn: 那么，我就先带他们回去了。多谢你的帮助。

choice:2:0:1.text: Looks like you still doubt me.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 看来你没有完全相信我啊
